visualCharacteristics.purpose: Search for a home lending officer by location or last name

contentPattern.structure: Mode rows Label | placeholder | query parameter (e.g. Search by location | Location | location). Optional key/value rows: Endpoint (JSON search URL), Results page (URL to navigate to with the query), Button, No results, Error

reuseGuidance: Without an Endpoint or Results page the block shows the Error message instead of searching. Use location-input for a single location field.
